release: NZB Identity Gate & Durable Downloads History
name: NZB Identity Gate & Durable Downloads History
changes: Validates actual TV NZB file-subject identity before SAB submission and rejects positively contradictory multi-episode/complete-season payloads for single-episode targets while allowing obfuscated/no-evidence NZBs.
Continues Automatic Downloads to the next candidate after an NZB-content rejection and records the rejected release in target-specific failure history.
Publishes a copy-on-write active-job presentation index so routine Live Downloads avoids full durable-ledger scans and blocking state-lock work.
Adds a compact NewzDeck-owned terminal-history index, bootstrapped from existing durable jobs, retained independently of SAB History and bounded to 5,000 rows.
Pages compact Completed/Failed rows from NewzDeck terminal history and loads rich transfer/PAR2 details lazily on demand.
Preserves queue-sampler last failure evidence and reason counts across subsequent successful samples.
regression_guards: The real Big Brother Canada S07E29 disguised-season-pack fixture must be rejected before queue submission; valid S07E29 and obfuscated fixtures must pass.
Automatic candidate fallback must continue to the next release after content rejection.
620 durable terminal jobs with only a 200-row SAB History window must remain page-accessible from NewzDeck terminal history.
Live presentation index must contain only active/non-terminal durable jobs plus terminal counts, and terminal details remain lazy.
Sampler last-failure evidence must survive a later successful sample.
All v3.6.52 and historical identity/Library Integrity/Selected Episodes/PAR2/SAB 5.1.2 guards remain mandatory.
